title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Rate Card: Block Rate for Long Rentals
content:
**Rate card.** The block rate used in the corrected time charge of a customer-pay Rental Vehicle Coordination rental tied to a network repair depends on the span between the pickup date and the return date: a span of 21 days or more takes the class weekly rate reduced by 15 percent; a span of 14 days or more but under 21 days takes the class weekly rate reduced by 10 percent; a shorter span takes the class weekly rate.

The span is the whole days between the pickup date and the return date, without regard to the times of day.

## Span bands

| Span between pickup date and return date | Block rate |
|---|---|
| Under 14 days | The class weekly rate |
| 14 to 20 days | The class weekly rate reduced by 10 percent |
| 21 days or more | The class weekly rate reduced by 15 percent |

## Block rates worked for each class

| Rental class | Weekly rate (USD) | Span 14 to 20 days (USD) | Span 21 days or more (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Rental | 229.00 | 206.10 | 194.65 |
| Compact Rental | 245.00 | 220.50 | 208.25 |
| Intermediate Rental | 269.00 | 242.10 | 228.65 |
| Full-Size Rental | 299.00 | 269.10 | 254.15 |
| Standard SUV Rental | 379.00 | 341.10 | 322.15 |
| Minivan Rental | 429.00 | 386.10 | 364.65 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Pickup on the 1st, return on the 14th: a span of 13 days, under 14, so the class weekly rate.
- Pickup on the 1st, return on the 15th: a span of 14 days, so the weekly rate reduced by 10 percent.
- Pickup on the 1st, return on the 21st: a span of 20 days, still under 21. Return on the 22nd: a span of 21 days, so the weekly rate reduced by 15 percent.
